This is a substantive same-rank cognitive escalation from explaining prevention/treatment principles to applying that knowledge to design containment strategies; proficiency in C222 supports success in C227, so direction runs second_to_first. Their differing CLO parents (CLO94 'describes spread, causes, prevention and treatment' vs CLO97 'applies knowledge ... to design preventive strategies') and differing LO parents (LO5 explain vs LO12 apply) corroborate the explain-to-apply ordering rather than mere wording overlap. Evidence limits: both endpoints carry upstream merge/audit context and truncated source evidence (32 omitted items each), so the judgment rests on the bounded descriptions, LCs, and parent paths.
